versions.changelog:
v1.0.2 switches fact extraction to run locally using Ollama — no external API required.

- Fact extraction now uses your local LLM (Ollama) for processing session transcripts, improving privacy and data control.
- Default setup requires no API key or external service; configuration simplified for local use.
- External OpenAI-compatible APIs are still supported via optional config.
- Documentation updated to reflect local-first architecture and setup instructions.
Added privacy/data handling disclosure: declares API key requirement, session transcript reading, and external API communication.

Initial release: comprehensive five-layer memory system for OpenClaw agents.

- Introduces hot, warm, and cold storage layers, with knowledge graph and self-learning directories.
- Automates fact extraction from sessions using an LLM-enabled memory-flush hook.
- Provides hybrid vector/keyword search across all memory layers.
- Detailed setup and configuration steps, including built-in and custom hooks.
- Clear file structure, loading rules, and behavioral guidelines for agent memory use.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common setup issues.
